fact: On 28 May 2025 the Secretary of State for Taxes told the Chamber that the property tax (IBI) is self-assessed by the taxpayer and paid to the Treasury, with the tax administration notifying the taxable value within 90 days of the owner's declaration.
title: Comparecencia del Secretario de Estado Encargado de Impuestos y Contribuciones
publisher: Página Oficial del Gobierno de la República de Guinea Ecuatorial
